fields.label: Sync Enabled
fields.description: When unchecked, inbound QBO payment and bill payment events are logged as Skipped-NoOp and no Payment Entries are created or cancelled.

fields.label: Webhook Shared Secret (HMAC)
fields.description: Shared secret used by n8n to sign requests to receive_payment_event (X-QBO-Signature = HMAC-SHA256 hex over the raw body). Generate a random 64-char value and store the same value in n8n. If site_config.json defines qbo_webhook_secret, that value takes precedence.

fields.label: Paid To Account
fields.description: Bank/Cash account that QBO customer payments post to.

fields.label: Paid From Account
fields.description: Bank account that bill payments made in QuickBooks are paid from. Bill payments fail until this is set.

fields.label: Bill Webhook URL
fields.description: n8n webhook that creates the QuickBooks Bill for a submitted Purchase Invoice and deletes it on cancel. Leave blank to send no bills.

fields.label: Send Bills Posted On or After
fields.description: Purchase Invoices posted before this date are never sent, so bills already entered in QuickBooks are not duplicated. Leave blank to send no bills.

fields.label: Endpoint Help
fields.options:
n8n posts normalized QBO events to:
POST /api/method/illumenate_lighting.illumenate_lighting.api.qbo_sync.receive_payment_event (customer payments)
POST /api/method/illumenate_lighting.illumenate_lighting.api.qbo_sync.receive_bill_payment_event (bill payments)
POST /api/method/illumenate_lighting.illumenate_lighting.api.qbo_bills.receive_bill_link (Bill id write-back)

Every inbound payment event is recorded in ilL-QBO-Sync-Log. n8n workflows: n8n_workflows/quickbooks_payment_sync.json and n8n_workflows/purchase_invoice_qbo_bill.json.
